summary: Pan American Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) reporting the results of its annual general and special meeting held April 30, 2026. Shareholders approved all management resolutions: setting board size at ten, electing all director nominees, appointing Deloitte LLP as auditor, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. A total of 290,835,897 common shares (68.95% of outstanding) were represented. There are no corporate events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or forced management changes. This filing is a routine current report of meeting results and does not constitute a special situation.
